name: Pending Purchase Orders
query:
SELECT 
    'Purchase Order' AS "Document Type",
    po.name AS "Document ID",
    po.supplier AS "Supplier",
    po.grand_total AS "Total Amount",
    po.workflow_state AS "Approval Status",
    po.status AS "Order Status",
    po.owner AS "Created By",
    po.creation AS "Created On"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Order` po
WHERE 
    po.workflow_state = "Pending Approval"

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Purchase Invoice' AS "Document Type",
    pi.name AS "Document ID",
    pi.supplier AS "Supplier",
    pi.grand_total AS "Total Amount",
    pi.workflow_state AS "Approval Status",
    pi.status AS "Invoice Status",
    pi.owner AS "Created By",
    pi.creation AS "Created On"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
WHERE 
    pi.workflow_state = "Pending Approval"

ORDER BY 
    `Created On` DESC;
